entries.090066c6e79cf51f: It is a category that sells workflow products as package software. 'X-point' features intuitive input forms similar to writing on paper. New license sales ended as of March 2022, and it now only provides support services and sells additional licenses. 'AgileWorks' inherits the functions of 'X-point' and is a product optimized for the operation of large organizations, with enhanced support for organizational restructuring and personnel transfers, and multilingual support. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,235 million, down 12.1% year on year, with product revenue of ¥185 million for 'X-point' and ¥1,049 million for 'AgileWorks'.
entries.1c3b7c8a801d0852: With a cumulative total of more than 5,000 adopting companies, the company states that its application forms, built with Java technology, offer operability "like paper." The company does not customize products for individual adopting companies; requests are reflected in version upgrades as needed, which it says allows development resources to be concentrated on strengthening product capability. The company states that it secures competitive advantage through a UI thoroughly designed from the user's perspective, the ability to operate systems in-house, extensive integration with other companies' systems, and its maintenance service structure.
entries.203bc73d2933e887: Its management philosophy is "Smoothing connections among people, work and organizations to co-create a future full of growth and smiles," and its ideal is "The power of workflow for all companies."
entries.2dcba9c741527a7e: With a cumulative total of more than 5,000 adopting companies, the company states that its application forms, built with Java technology, offer operability "like paper."
entries.2f80871968465f6c: Its customers range from small companies to large enterprises with tens of thousands of employees, and sales are mainly made through sales partner companies such as system integrators (SIers).
entries.2ff6beac9716253f: It is a category that offers 'X-point Cloud', which provides the X-point package software via the cloud (mainly targeting small and mid-sized companies with fewer than 1,000 employees), and 'AgileWorks Cloud Edition', which provides the AgileWorks package software via the cloud (mainly targeting mid-sized and large companies with 500 to 5,000 employees). Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,667 million, up 22.5% year on year. Amounts are not disclosed separately by product.
entries.54712afd9b7f2099: Net income for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥716 million.

entries.7bd271b9e230f536: Its management philosophy is "Smoothing connections among people, work and organizations to co-create a future full of growth and smiles," and its ideal is "The power of workflow for all companies." Against the backdrop of expanding workflow and cloud service markets, the company states that it aims to increase sales of AgileWorks, aimed at large and mid-sized companies, and of the cloud services X-point Cloud and AgileWorks cloud version. Its stated challenges are strengthening product functionality and expanding new services, strengthening its sales structure and brand recognition, and promoting work style reform and DX, and it positions workflow systems as "First DX," the first DX that companies undertake.

entries.ada77d4875d90e55: It is a business that develops and sells workflow products that digitize administrative flows, from internal approval requests and applications through to approval and sign-off, across a wide range of corporate operations. It independently develops products that use Java technology and are adapted to Japanese business processes, with more than 5,000 companies adopting them to date. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,902 million. It conducts business from its head office and an office in Shibuya-ku, Tokyo.

entries.eb57137509d58d6c: Of revenue of ¥2,902 million from a single segment, cloud services accounted for ¥1,667 million, a majority, exceeding packaged software. Approximately 90% of sales are made through sales partners, and Ricoh Company, Ltd. is named as a major customer. Against a backdrop of a declining birthrate, an aging population and a shrinking workforce, which have made improving labor productivity a challenge, the company states that demand for workflow software driven by DX promotion expanded and remained firm.
